items.name: OpenClaw
items.description: A personal assistant that connects models, tools and messaging surfaces to carry out multi-step tasks.
items.description_zh: 连接模型、工具与消息入口，处理需要多步完成的个人任务。
items.requirements: Configure a model and the tools it may use; local installation does not make a hosted model local. Start with a read-only folder task.
items.requirements_zh: 先配置模型和可用工具；装在本机不代表所选模型也在本机。起步先给一个只读资料任务。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Hermes Agent
items.description: An assistant with reusable skills, persistent context and terminal or messaging interfaces.
items.description_zh: 可保留上下文、复用技能，通过终端或消息入口完成任务的助理。
items.requirements: Choose a model provider and execution backend. Inspect created skills before reusing them; provider and hosted-backend charges are separate.
items.requirements_zh: 先选模型服务与运行环境。复用前检查自动生成的技能；模型和托管运行环境可能单独收费。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Deep Agents
items.description: An agent harness with planning, filesystem context and subagent building blocks for longer tasks.
items.description_zh: 提供计划、文件上下文和子任务组件，用来开发持续多步工作的智能体。
items.requirements: This is a development foundation, not a ready-made office assistant. Supply a tool-calling model, tools and an appropriate execution environment.
items.requirements_zh: 它是开发底座，需要接入能调用工具的模型、工具和运行环境，并非装好就能用的办公软件。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: n8n
items.interface_zh: 可视化 / 自托管或云端
items.description: Connect triggers, application integrations and AI steps into a repeatable workflow.
items.description_zh: 把触发条件、应用连接和 AI 步骤串成可重复执行的流程。
items.requirements: Configure service credentials and a model where needed. Self-hosting, cloud plans and model calls have different costs; n8n uses fair-code licenses.
items.requirements_zh: 按流程准备应用凭据和模型。自托管、云套餐与模型调用分开计费；n8n 使用 fair-code 许可。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Activepieces
items.interface_zh: 可视化 / 自托管或云端
items.description: Build app-to-app flows with reusable integration pieces and AI actions.
items.description_zh: 用现成连接组件和 AI 动作搭建应用之间的工作流。
items.requirements: Connect only the services a flow needs. Community Edition is MIT; enterprise features and hosted plans have separate terms.
items.requirements_zh: 只接入当前流程需要的服务。社区版为 MIT，企业功能与托管套餐另有条款。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Dify
items.description: Create AI applications using model configuration, document retrieval and workflow steps.
items.description_zh: 通过配置模型、检索文档和编排步骤来创建 AI 应用。
items.requirements: Needs a deployed instance and model/embedding services for the chosen flow. The Dify license includes conditions beyond Apache 2.0.
items.requirements_zh: 需要先有可用实例，并按流程配置模型与嵌入服务。Dify 许可含 Apache 2.0 之外的附加条件。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Langflow
items.interface_zh: 桌面或服务部署 / 可视化
items.description: Compose AI components visually and expose a finished flow through its APIs or tool interfaces.
items.description_zh: 可视化组合 AI 组件，将完成的流程交给应用或其他工具调用。
items.requirements: Use a supported desktop package or deploy the service, configure authentication and connect a model. A visual canvas still needs working components and credentials.
items.requirements_zh: 可以用受支持的桌面包，或自行部署，再配置登录与模型。能拖组件不代表组件已自动配置好。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Docling
items.description: Parse documents into structured representations for search, extraction and AI workflows.
items.description_zh: 把文档解析成结构化内容，供检索、提取和后续 AI 流程使用。
items.requirements: Prepare the parser models and a suitable runtime. Code is MIT; individual model licenses and complex-layout quality need separate checks.
items.requirements_zh: 先准备解析模型和运行环境。代码为 MIT，模型许可另看说明，复杂排版需要对照原件检查。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: MinerU
items.description: Convert complex PDFs and office documents into Markdown or JSON for downstream processing.
items.description_zh: 将复杂 PDF 和办公文档转换成 Markdown 或 JSON，交给后续流程处理。
items.requirements: Choose a supported parsing backend and prepare models. Code includes additional license conditions; hosted parsing and local execution differ.
items.requirements_zh: 选择适合设备的解析后端并准备模型。许可含附加条件；在线解析服务与本机运行的要求不同。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Marker
items.description: Convert documents to Markdown or JSON while retaining useful layout and table structure.
items.description_zh: 把文档转为 Markdown 或 JSON，并尽量保留版面、表格等结构。
items.requirements: Check the current backend and model requirements. Apache-2.0 code and the model weights have different commercial-use terms.
items.requirements_zh: 先看当前后端和模型要求。代码为 Apache-2.0，模型权重的商用条款另行规定。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: MarkItDown
items.description: Turn supported office and other files into Markdown that is easier to inspect and feed into AI tools.
items.description_zh: 把支持的办公文件等转换成易读的 Markdown，便于检查并交给 AI 工具。
items.requirements: Basic conversion is not an AI agent. Optional image-description and document-intelligence routes require their own services and credentials.
items.requirements_zh: 基础转换本身不是 AI 智能体；可选的图片描述、文档智能服务需要另行配置。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: AnythingLLM
items.description: Organize documents in workspaces and ask questions using configured language and embedding models.
items.description_zh: 把文档放进工作区，再通过配置的语言模型和嵌入模型进行问答。
items.requirements: Desktop is a practical starting point. Check the chosen model route, file parsers and workspace sources; cloud providers may receive content.
items.requirements_zh: 可以从桌面版起步。确认模型运行位置、文件解析方式与引用来源；选择云模型时资料可能发给云服务。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: RAGFlow
items.description: Build document-grounded retrieval and question-answering workflows with parsing and agent features.
items.description_zh: 结合文档解析、检索和智能体功能，搭建围绕资料的问答流程。
items.requirements: Prepare the service stack, storage and model providers. The current upstream Docker guide excludes macOS; follow its supported deployment route.
items.requirements_zh: 需要服务组件、存储，以及语言模型、嵌入等服务。当前上游 Docker 部署文档不支持 macOS，需按受支持路线准备。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Onyx
items.description: Connect team knowledge sources and provide AI search and chat over indexed information.
items.description_zh: 连接团队资料源，建立索引后进行 AI 搜索和问答。
items.requirements: Connector access, indexing and model routing need configuration. Edition-specific licensing and source permissions matter for a team deployment.
items.requirements_zh: 先配置连接器权限、索引和模型。团队部署还要区分版本许可，并保留原资料的访问边界。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Open Notebook
items.description: Keep source material, notes and model-assisted conversations together in a notebook workspace.
items.description_zh: 把资料、笔记和模型辅助对话放在同一个笔记工作区。
items.requirements: Configure the services used for language, embedding, speech or generated audio. Self-hosting the notebook does not make every provider local.
items.requirements_zh: 按需要配置语言、嵌入、语音等服务；笔记系统自托管，不代表每种模型服务都在本地。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: GPT Researcher
items.interface_zh: 研究智能体 / 需配置
items.description: Gather material and generate a research report with source references.
items.description_zh: 围绕问题搜集资料，整理带来源链接的研究报告。
items.requirements: Configure the selected model and search/data providers and set a run budget. Check that citations support each claim and are current.
items.requirements_zh: 配置模型、搜索或资料服务，并给每次任务设置预算；逐条核对引用是否支持结论、是否过时。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: DeerFlow
items.interface_zh: 智能体平台 / 需配置
items.description: Coordinate longer research and creation tasks with tools, files and a configured execution environment.
items.description_zh: 结合工具、文件和运行环境，组织较长的研究与内容制作任务。
items.requirements: Configure the model, optional search and sandbox/tool access. Its broader execution capability requires more setup than a search box.
items.requirements_zh: 先配置模型、可选搜索和工具运行环境；执行能力更广，准备工作也比普通搜索框多。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Browser Use
items.interface_zh: 开发工具 / 浏览器智能体
items.description: Use a language-model agent to navigate pages and perform browser tasks.
items.description_zh: 让语言模型驱动浏览器，完成页面读取、导航和操作。
items.requirements: The library, hosted browser and hosted models are separate offerings. Start with public read-only extraction and a bounded output schema.
items.requirements_zh: 代码库、托管浏览器与托管模型是不同服务。建议先从公开网页的只读提取开始，并规定输出字段。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Stagehand
items.description: Combine browser actions and structured extraction in an application workflow.
items.description_zh: 在程序中组合浏览器操作与结构化信息提取。
items.requirements: Requires programming and a model configuration; browser hosting depends on the deployment route. Validate extracted fields against the page.
items.requirements_zh: 需要写代码并配置模型；浏览器是否托管取决于使用方式。提取结果应回到原页面核对。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Skyvern
items.interface_zh: 浏览器流程 / 需配置
items.description: Automate browser workflows using model-assisted page understanding and visual interaction.
items.description_zh: 结合页面理解和视觉操作，自动执行浏览器中的流程。
items.requirements: Configure a model and browser environment. Local/self-hosted and managed services differ; AGPL code terms apply to the selected edition.
items.requirements_zh: 先准备模型和浏览器环境。本机、自托管与托管服务不同，所用版本需遵守相应 AGPL 等条款。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: faster-whisper
items.description: Transcribe recordings using Whisper models through CTranslate2.
items.description_zh: 通过 CTranslate2 运行 Whisper 模型，将录音转成文字。
items.requirements: Download models and choose CPU or a compatible GPU setup. It produces a transcript, not a trustworthy summary or action list by itself.
items.requirements_zh: 先下载模型，并选择 CPU 或兼容的 GPU 环境。它输出转写稿，本身不保证纪要和待办正确。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: WhisperX
items.description: Add alignment, word-level timestamps and optional speaker diarization to transcription.
items.description_zh: 为转写增加对齐、词级时间戳和可选的说话人分离。
items.requirements: Alignment and diarization have separate models and requirements; some downloads need provider access acceptance. Speaker labels do not identify real people.
items.requirements_zh: 对齐和分说话人需要各自的模型，部分下载需服务账户确认访问条件。说话人标签不等于真实身份。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Meetily
items.description: Capture or import meeting audio, transcribe it and generate model-assisted summaries.
items.description_zh: 录制或导入会议音频，转写后生成模型辅助纪要。
items.requirements: Choose local or hosted summary models. Windows/macOS packages and Linux source setup differ, as do Community and PRO features. Check commitments against the recording.
items.requirements_zh: 选择本地或云端纪要模型。Windows/macOS 安装包与 Linux 源码部署不同，社区与 PRO 功能也不同；待办要对照录音检查。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Data Formulator
items.interface_zh: 交互式分析 / 需配置
items.description: Explore data with AI-assisted transformations and visualizations.
items.description_zh: 通过 AI 辅助的数据变换与可视化来探索表格。
items.requirements: Prepare the data and supported model route. Recompute totals, filters and denominators before using a generated chart in a report.
items.requirements_zh: 先准备数据和受支持的模型。把图表用于报告前，重新核对汇总、筛选条件和分母。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Presenton
items.description: Generate, edit and export presentations using a configured model and your source material.
items.description_zh: 根据提供的资料和配置的模型生成、编辑并导出演示文稿。
items.requirements: Use the desktop or self-hosted app, configure a model and any image services, then visually inspect the actual editable PPTX export.
items.requirements_zh: 可以从桌面版或自托管应用起步，配置模型和需要的图片服务。导出可编辑 PPTX 后，打开检查实际排版。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Banana Slides
items.description: Create slide decks from ideas, outlines, source documents and visual references.
items.description_zh: 从想法、大纲、资料和视觉参考生成幻灯片。
items.requirements: Configure supported language/image providers. Image calls may cost extra; editable PPTX export is marked Beta and needs inspection.
items.requirements_zh: 先配置支持的语言和图像服务，生图可能另收费。可编辑 PPTX 导出目前标为 Beta，需要检查实际文件。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: PPTAgent
items.interface_zh: 开发工具 / 智能体技能
items.description: Create and revise presentations through an agent-assisted generation and review workflow.
items.description_zh: 通过智能体辅助的生成与审阅流程制作、修改演示文稿。
items.requirements: The current main branch uses an agent-skill route with Linux/WSL or macOS, development tools and LibreOffice conversion dependencies. Follow the matching version.
items.requirements_zh: 当前主线以智能体技能为入口，需要 Linux/WSL 或 macOS、开发工具及 LibreOffice 等转换依赖；按对应版本配置。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: promptfoo
items.description: Compare prompts or models against reusable test cases and output assertions.
items.description_zh: 用可复用题目和输出要求，对比不同提示词或模型。
items.requirements: Model-based runs may cost money. Deterministic checks and model-judged scores answer different questions; inspect failures, not just a single score.
items.requirements_zh: 模型运行可能付费。确定性规则和模型打分检查的内容不同；要看失败样例，不能只看总分。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Langfuse
items.description: Trace AI application runs and organize evaluation, datasets and feedback.
items.description_zh: 记录 AI 应用的运行过程，组织评估、数据集和反馈。
items.requirements: Instrument the application and choose where traces are stored. Community and enterprise features differ; traces may contain prompts and outputs.
items.requirements_zh: 先为应用接入追踪，并选择日志存放位置。社区与企业功能不同，记录中可能包含提示词和输出内容。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested

items.name: Arize Phoenix
items.description: Inspect model and retrieval traces and evaluate AI application behavior.
items.description_zh: 查看模型、检索等过程记录，评估 AI 应用的行为。
items.requirements: Instrumentation and evaluation still require setup and may use model services. Phoenix uses Elastic License 2.0; do not assume an MIT/Apache grant.
items.requirements_zh: 接入追踪与评估需要配置，也可能调用模型服务。Phoenix 使用 Elastic License 2.0，不应按 MIT 或 Apache 理解。
items.review_level: Primary README and metadata reviewed; application not runtime-tested
